Title: New regions for HDInsight: East Asia, North Central US, and South Central US

Body.Content: HDInsight has now expanded its geographical presence to three new regions: East Asia, North Central US, and South Central US. Customers can now create HDInsight clusters in East US, West US, North Central US, South Central US, North Europe, West Europe, East Asia, and Southeast Asia. To learn more about HDInsight, see the HDInsight webpage. For more HDInsight pricing information, see the HDInsight Pricing Details webpage.
